mLocKeys.keySummary: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them. He then follows them and aids their attacks. If cast on an enemy, commands Pix to jump to an enemy and damage them. He then follows them and grants you vision of that enemy.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
When used on an ally, Pix jumps to them and grants Pix, Faerie Companion for @PixOnAllyDuration@ seconds. If the ally is a champion, Pix also grants @TotalShield@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

When used on an enemy champion, Pix hampers them, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage and granting True Sight of them for @PixOnEnemyDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription:
Pix's ''Assistance''Pix is following this unit, revealing this unit to his allies and being generally annoying.

Hey! Listen!Source: @SourceName@

<titleLeft>Pix's Assistance</titleLeft><mainText>Pix is following this unit and shielding it from incoming damage. When this unit attacks, Pix will aid this unit instead of Lulu.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

Pix, Faerie CompanionPix fires a barrage of 3 bolts, dealing @f1@ (+@f2@) magic damage total, at whomever Lulu attacks.

These bolts are homing but can be blocked by other units.Source: @SourceName@

mLocKeys.keySummary: Pix fires magical bolts of energy whenever the champion he's following attacks another enemy unit. These bolts are homing, but can be intercepted by other units.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Lulu is assisted by Pix the faerie. When Lulu Attacks, Pix fires 3 bolts at her target, dealing <magicDamage>@CombinedDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to the first enemy hit.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Pix and Lulu each fire a bolt of magical energy that damages and heavily slows all enemies it hits.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Lulu and Pix each fire a piercing bolt dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage and Slowing by @SlowAmount*-100@%, decaying over @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Enemies take @BonusMissileDamage@ magic damage from additional bolts.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Glittertrance</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's Move Speed is heavily reduced but they will recover over time.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Wild Growth</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's health is increased and they will periodically slow nearby enemies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health. For the next few seconds, that ally gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Lulu enlarges an ally, <status>Knocking Up</status> surrounding enemies for @KnockbackDuration@ second. The enlarged ally gains <healing>@TotalBonusHealth@ max Health</healing> and <status>Slows</status> surrounding enemies by @SlowPercent@% for @BuffDuration@ seconds.

Elements.nameOverride: Move Speed and Attack Speed Duration

mLocKeys.keySummary: If cast on an ally, grants them Attack Speed and Move Speed for a short time. If cast on an enemy, turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
When used on an ally, Lulu grants @TotalMS@ Move Speed and @ASBonus*100@% Attack Speed for @MSDuration@ seconds.

When used on an enemy, Lulu Polymorphs them for @CCDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Lulu's Assistance</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's attack and Move Speed is increased.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

Lulu's ''Assistance''This unit is pacified and cannot attack or cast spells.

This unit is also adorable.Source: @SourceName@
